speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked 	the Minister for National Development whether URA is (i) reviewing the rule of allowing developers to build large air-con ledges and balconies for non-landed residential properties without them being counted as part of the gross floor area and yet are allowed to be charged to buyers for such space and (ii) making it mandatory to state the floor areas dedicated for balconies, air-con ledges and other outdoor space in the floor plans of such properties during their launches.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The rules on what constitutes GFA are publicly available on URA's website.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Developers factor in strata area when pricing units in their developments.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Strata area measures the amount of floor space to be sold to the buyer, on the basis that the space is for the buyer's exclusive enjoyment.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Home buyers are advised to review the information in order to make an informed decision over their purchases.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Because of this, the developers apparently build extra-large balconies, sometimes, one-third to half the space of the liveable space inside the apartment.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: That has caused some misery among the buyers.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: We hope that MND can consider regulating the size of balconies.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: This was an issue that was publicised in the media recently.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: That is a separate matter from a Bonus GFA matter.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: I think it has generally worked well in providing us buildings and residential developments that add to our physical landscape.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: Part of it is making sure that the information that is provided to buyers is very clear: what constitutes balcony space, what constitutes usable space.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: As I have said, this information is mandatory and we will continue to make sure that developers publicise the information properly.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: We encourage home buyers to look at the prospectus carefully, especially if they are buying flats based on plans, and make informed decisions about their purchases.
